methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine high-search rowing machines spanning air, water, magnetic, and hybrid resistance: Concept2 RowErg, Hydrow Origin (formerly Pro), Hydrow Wave, Ergatta Luxe, NordicTrack RW900, WaterRower (Original Series oak), Echelon Row-s, Aviron Strong Series, and Sunny Health SF-RW5515. Prices re-verified 2026-06 against manufacturer pages and reputable editorial reviews (BarBend, PopSci, Garage Gym Reviews, Start Rowing, Rowing Crazy). priceUsd reflects current published US MSRP/retail for the EXACT named model; where a model is routinely discounted the standing retail price is used and noted. Adversarial corrections this pass: the draft's 'Ergatta Rower' conflated the Lite (17.3in/320lb) with the Luxe (21in/500lb) and listed a 2020 release for a 500lb/$2,499 unit that is the Luxe (launched Nov 2025) - resolved to Ergatta Luxe with corrected screen and release; NordicTrack RW900 capacity corrected 300->250lb; WaterRower price corrected $1,599->$1,099 (the published oak Original Series MSRP) and renamed from the unofficial 'Classic'; Aviron Strong Series release corrected 2024->2022. Boolean specs: foldable and subscription_required reflect yes/no; subscription_required is true when the interactive platform needs a paid plan beyond trial. weight_lb is the assembled unit without water where applicable (NordicTrack figure is manufacturer in-box weight, as NordicTrack does not publish assembled weight). max_user_weight_lb is manufacturer-stated capacity. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Concept2 RowErg
products.provenance: Price $990 (standard legs) / $1,155 (tall legs) confirmed on the official Concept2 product page and Garage Gym Reviews 2026. Air resistance via fanned flywheel with 1-10 spiral damper. Max user weight 500 lb is Concept2's figure; the EN 20957-7 standard rating is 300 lb. Separates into two pieces tool-free for storage but does not fold -> foldable false. The 'RowErg' name is the 2021 rebrand of the Model D, first introduced July 2003; releaseDate 2003 reflects the original Model D introduction. PM5 monitor is the current-shipping monitor (original 2003 Model D shipped PM3).

products.name: Hydrow Origin (formerly Hydrow Pro)
products.priceNote: MSRP; frequently discounted to ~$1,895 during promotions
products.provenance: $2,195 MSRP confirmed via Hydrow listing and multiple 2026 reviews; routinely promoted near $1,895. Patented electromagnetic (magnetic) drag. 22in touchscreen pivots ~25deg horizontally / tilts ~15deg. Dimensions 86L x 25W x 47H, weight 145 lb, 375 lb capacity confirmed by Amazon listing and reviews. Originally 'Hydrow Pro,' rebranded 'Hydrow Origin' ~2023. All-Access membership ~$44-$50/mo; a limited 'Just Row' mode exists without subscription, so subscription_required is true for the interactive experience.

products.name: Hydrow Wave
products.provenance: Dimensions 80L x 19W x 43H, weight 102 lb, 375 lb capacity, 16in fixed touchscreen confirmed across BarBend, Start Rowing, Coach, and GGR. Price ~$1,495-$1,500 (most recent retailer/editorial figure). Same electromagnetic drag as Origin; ~30% smaller, polycarbonate frame. Stores vertically by removing a pin; does not fold. All-Access membership ~$44-$50/mo required for content. Wave debuted in 2022 (release_year corrected from a draft that left it as 2023); still in lineup alongside Origin and the newer Arc.

products.name: Ergatta Luxe
products.priceNote: MSRP; launched at $1,999 promotional price Nov 2025
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM DRAFT: the draft's 'Ergatta Rower' mixed the Lite (17.3in screen, 320 lb, 72 lb) with the Luxe (21in screen, 500 lb, ~106.5 lb) and gave a 2020 release for a 500lb/$2,499 unit. Resolved to the Ergatta Luxe, the current flagship: $2,499 MSRP with a $1,999 launch price, launched November 2025 (Ergatta press release), 21in HD touchscreen (was wrongly 17.3in), 500 lb capacity, ~106.5 lb with water (was 103), cherrywood, handcrafted by WaterRower. Water resistance. Membership ~$29/mo required for gamified content. (The 17.3in/320lb/$1,299 Lite is a separate, lower model not represented here.)

products.name: NordicTrack RW900
products.priceNote: Retailer price ~$1,999-$2,000; NordicTrack.com lists higher with options/membership
products.provenance: CORRECTED: max_user_weight_lb 300->250 lb per BarBend, Garage Gym Reviews, and NordicTrack FAQ. 24in pivoting HD touchscreen confirmed on the official NordicTrack page, GGR, and Wellbots (BarBend's older review text said 22in, an earlier variant; 24in is current). 26 magnetic resistance levels. Footprint ~82L x 22W x 54H. Machine weight 158 lb is the manufacturer in-box weight (NordicTrack does not publish assembled weight). Standing retail ~$1,999-$2,000 (Academy Sports, BarBend); NordicTrack.com lists higher with membership/options. iFit subscription ~$39/mo required for interactive content. Does not fold or store vertically. Release date not reliably documented -> null.

products.name: WaterRower Original Series (Oak)
products.priceNote: Published MSRP for oak Original Series with S4 monitor; varies by wood/retailer (~$1,099-$1,199)
products.provenance: CORRECTED: priceUsd $1,599->$1,099 (BarBend lists the oak WaterRower Original Series at $1,099; $1,199 for some wood/configs). Renamed from the unofficial 'Classic' to 'WaterRower Original Series (Oak)' - WaterRower's marketed line is the Original Series; the model is 'The Classic Since 1988' but there is no separate 'Classic' SKU. Source URL fixed to a live waterrower.com/us product page. Max user weight 700 lb and dry weight 66.5 lb (rounded 67) confirmed by BarBend; footprint 82L x 22W x 20H. Stands upright on dolly wheels; does not fold. No subscription. WaterRower line dates to 1988 but the specific product release year is not precisely documented -> null.

products.name: Echelon Row-s
products.priceNote: Current echelonfit.com price; MSRP ~$1,899.99 per BarBend (frequently discounted; Walmart ~$683)
products.provenance: Current echelonfit.com price $799.99 (Walmart ~$683). MSRP corrected: BarBend lists $1,899.99 (the draft's '$1,599 original MSRP' was inaccurate). Max user weight 350 lb, weight 114-114.5 lb, 22in rotating HD touchscreen, 32 magnetic levels, all confirmed by BarBend. Foldable: yes (folds to ~41L x 21W x 60H). Footprint ~84L x 21W x 45H unfolded. Echelon Premier membership $39.99/mo required for live/on-demand classes. Release date not reliably documented -> null.

products.name: Aviron Strong Series
products.priceNote: MSRP; promotional pricing as low as ~$1,699-$1,899 observed
products.provenance: CORRECTED: release year 2024->2022. Aviron's own PRNewswire release ('Aviron Debuts New Strong Series Rower') dates the launch to October 2022 as successor to the Tough Series. $2,499 MSRP confirmed by BarBend and Live Science; promoted as low as ~$1,699-$1,899. Dual air+magnetic (hybrid) resistance, 16 levels. 22in rotating HD touchscreen. Footprint 84L x 27W x 48H (BarBend); ~83.5in length per Live Science. 507 lb capacity; weight 113.5-114 lb. Membership $29/mo (or ~$24/mo annual) for gamified content. Does not fold; supports upright storage.

products.name: Sunny Health & Fitness SF-RW5515

specs.monitor_or_touchscreen: LCD display (time, distance, calories, stroke count)

products.provenance: Official MSRP $399.99 per BarBend; common street price ~$249.99 (Lowe's, Walmart, garagegym reviews). priceUsd set to the official MSRP $399.99 (street price noted). Dimensions in use 82L x 18.9W x 23.6H (rounded 82 x 19), 250 lb max user weight, machine weight 60.9 lb (rounded 60, was 59), 8 magnetic resistance levels, foldable (folds to ~43.3L x 18.9W x 52.4H). LCD console; no app/Bluetooth/subscription. Release date not documented -> null.
